title: NLKE Grounded Continuity Architecture
subtitle: Take a step back from the product and follow its claims into the system that makes them true.

grounding_layers.title: Durable collaboration
grounding_layers.summary: Sessions, typed and spoken turns, facts, episodes, proposals, and receipts preserve continuity without giving a model silent write authority.

grounding_layers.title: Declared repository architecture
grounding_layers.summary: Versioned AI cards, sections, graph edges, embeddings, health, and visible gaps describe what the repository says is true.

grounding_layers.title: Human and visual intent
grounding_layers.summary: Role-labelled images become bounded findings, unresolved choices, and an editable Open Plan. Raw screenshots are discarded.

grounding_layers.title: Executable context
grounding_layers.summary: Trusted capabilities, the command registry, active UI state, and persona profiles determine what Aria may offer right now.

claims.title: Grounding is bounded and repository-scoped
claims.plain: Aria and Codex receive a selected packet with explicit omissions and degraded reasons—not an unrestricted database dump.
claims.failure: Unknown repository identity fails closed; unavailable dense retrieval remains visible as a degraded reason.

claims.title: Published handoffs cannot silently change
claims.plain: A published packet is version-pinned. Editing creates a new lineage version while the original remains inspectable.
claims.failure: A direct patch of a published handoff returns a conflict instead of mutating history.

claims.title: The architecture exhibit proves its own source boundary
claims.plain: The visible story is curated, but its modules, routes, tables, commands, tests, excerpts, claim links, and snapshot hash are compiled from the same repository it explains.
claims.failure: A missing source, regression test, unknown layer, unsafe local path, or stale generated artifact fails the atlas build instead of publishing an unsupported receipt.

supports.needle: Select any claim. Follow it into the backend.

claims.title: Aria never stores raw audio
claims.plain: WebRTC audio travels directly between the browser and OpenAI. Command Center stores only bounded transcript events and transport receipts.
claims.failure: Audio, SDP, WebRTC payloads, authorization values, and credentials are removed or redacted from receipt inputs.

claims.title: Screenshot pixels are not retained
claims.plain: Screenshots are validated and resized in memory, then reduced to hashes, dimensions, roles, and labelled findings.
claims.failure: Unsupported or corrupt image bytes are rejected before analysis; stored receipts always report retained=false.

claims.title: Database records cannot inject executable commands
claims.plain: The database stores versioned command metadata and aliases. Executable behavior remains in a typed, allow-listed TypeScript controller.
claims.failure: The coverage gate rejects a manifest handler with no controller and protects confirmation classifications from drift.

claims.title: Buttons and voice invoke the same semantic actions
claims.plain: Voice function calls do not synthesize clicks or DOM coordinates. They enter the same typed controller used by product controls and tests.
claims.failure: Unknown, malformed, disabled, or out-of-scope commands return bounded failures instead of touching the interface.

claims.title: Durable memory requires a human tap
claims.plain: Models may draft pending proposals. Only the authenticated confirmation endpoint can create or change durable memory.
claims.failure: Rejection and policy refusal are auditable; neither creates a durable memory row.

claims.title: Publication keeps an exact human gate
claims.plain: Voice may publish a prepared handoff only after hearing the exact phrase “Approve this handoff.”
claims.failure: Aliases cannot use the reserved phrase, and partial or paraphrased approval cannot cross the boundary.

claims.title: Workspaces and BYOK remain isolated
claims.plain: Browser workspaces are independently authenticated. Provider keys live only in an expiring encrypted session envelope and never enter memory or handoffs.
claims.failure: Missing keys degrade optional model features; they do not redirect usage to an operator-funded credential.

lineage.title: Manual Memory Log
lineage.summary: Before knowing the vocabulary of RAG or agent frameworks, explicit context, a single source of truth, factual framing, and logic-gated progression established the core grounding principle.
principles: Context is supplied, never assumed → Grounding Compiler
Only explicit facts may influence reasoning → versioned grounding receipts
New conclusions must follow known inputs → human gates and immutable handoffs
